title: Sun Yat Sen

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
P. O. REG
No. 254
Date 29/5/26

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 27th 1916.

Sir,
The rebels held a meeting in No.14 Blue
Chapel At 7 p.m. 26th instant for the purpose
of electing a successor to Chen Chi Ke 陳其美.
Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙 Li Ping Shu 李平書 Han Hwe 韓恢
and Tsu Tuh 周德 were present.
Chui Tsung 民正 was unanimously selected, but
he declined to accept the post. It was announced
that a further meeting would be held in three days time.
The brother and wife of Chen Chi Ke went to the
residence of Sun Yat Sen at No.713 Avenue Joffre and
created a disturbance on 26th instant.
The Shanghai Arsenal has sent 100 gunners to
Nanking. They travelled in civilian clothes.
It is reported that the situation is becoming
critical at Sungkiang.
Colonel Zau Ying Bang 趙雲邦 one of Chiangchun
Fong's staff officers, is constantly travelling
between Shanghai and Nanking. Every time he
visits this city, he has secret conferences with
General Yang.
The troops at Woosung have instructions to
hold themselves in readiness to leave that place.
It is thought that they will be used against Chekiang.

Your Obedient Servant,

（签名）

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（手写批注）
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
警务处登记号
第 254 号
日期 1926年5月29日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警察部队）
警察部队，
（侦探科）

1916年5月27日。

先生：

叛乱分子于本月26日晚7时在蓝教堂14号举行会议，目的是选举陈其美的继任者。孙中山、李平书、韩恢和周德出席了会议。民正被一致推选，但他拒绝接受该职位。会上宣布，三天后将再次举行会议。

陈其美的兄弟和妻子于本月26日前往霞飞路713号孙中山的寓所闹事。

上海兵工厂已派遣100名炮手前往南京。他们身着便服出行。

据报，松江局势正变得危急。

赵云邦上校是蒋尊方的一名参谋军官，经常往返于上海和南京之间。他每次来到本市，都会与杨将军举行秘密会谈。

吴淞的部队已接到指令，随时准备撤离该地。人们认为他们将用于对付浙江。

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

首席探长。

警司。

（手写批注）
